content.text: Why This Infrastructure Works When Platforms Fail

The COREMERCH infrastructure is built on a foundation of free and paid tools that provide a complete digital commerce stack. By leveraging GitHub Pages or Cloudflare Pages for hosting, Cloudflare Workers or Google Apps Script for backend logic, and Supabase or Google Sheets for order storage, you can create a fully operational online store without relying on restrictive platforms like Stripe or PayPal. This approach ensures that you maintain full data ownership and control over your store.
What You Need Before You Deploy

Before deploying your online store, you need to select the right tools and configure them correctly. This includes choosing a hosting platform, setting up backend logic, and configuring order storage. You also need to integrate a payment gateway like NOWPayments, which supports over 300 cryptocurrencies and charges a low fee of 0.5%. With the right tools and configuration, you can create a seamless and efficient payment and delivery pipeline.
Setting Up Your Payment and Delivery Pipeline

Setting up your payment and delivery pipeline involves integrating NOWPayments with your online store and configuring instant product delivery. This ensures that customers receive their digital products immediately after payment confirmation. You can use Google Drive or Cloudflare R2 for file delivery, which provides a fast and reliable way to distribute your digital products. By automating the payment and delivery process, you can focus on creating and marketing your products.
Deploy your online store with confidence.
Going Live and Processing Your First Transaction

Once you've deployed your online store and configured your payment and delivery pipeline, you're ready to go live and process your first transaction. This involves testing your store to ensure that everything is working correctly, from payment processing to product delivery. With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can start selling your digital products and earning a living from your craft, without relying on restrictive platforms or intermediaries.
Scaling Once the Infrastructure Is Running

As your online store grows and you start processing more transactions, you need to scale your infrastructure to ensure that it can handle increased traffic and demand. This involves monitoring your store's performance, optimizing your backend logic, and upgrading your hosting and storage solutions as needed. With the COREMERCH infrastructure, you can scale your online store with confidence, knowing that you have a solid foundation in place to support your growth.
How can creators in Africa sell digital products to international buyers?

The COREMERCH infrastructure provides a direct answer to the problem of restrictive payment platforms, offering a sovereign commerce solution that puts you in control of your online store and digital products. With automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery, you can focus on creating and marketing your products, without worrying about platform restrictions or intermediaries.
Scale your business without platform restrictions.

The Complete Builder Kit, available at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html for $197, provides everything you need to deploy your own online store with sovereign commerce infrastructure. This comprehensive kit includes all the tools and expertise necessary to create a fully operational store with automatic crypto payment processing and instant product delivery.
Your Deployment Checklist

Confirm which cryptocurrencies have the best P2P conversion options in your specific country before configuring your payment settings — USDT on Tron is a safe starting point for most African and South Asian markets. Create your NOWPayments account and add wallet addresses for your primary coins. Set up a P2P exchange account — Binance P2P is available in most restricted markets and supports local currency pairs. Deploy your chosen stack: Stack 01 via the Sovereign Blueprint or Stack 02 via the Edge Commerce Stack deployment. Configure the NOWPayments IPN webhook URL in your account settings pointing to your backend endpoint. Run a complete mainnet test transaction and confirm the pipeline end-to-end before promoting. Complete a test P2P conversion with a small amount so you know the process before your first real sale.
